title: Define the Retriever interface and an independent retrieval config
description:
## Purpose

Define the `Retriever` interface and a retrieval config that is independent of the few-shot optimizer, so retrieval can be switched on or off and swapped without touching the default path.

## Scope

- Protocols from design §4.1: `Retriever.index(task, pool)` over trusted labeled items only; `RetrievalIndex.top_per_label(target, label, k, exclude_ids)`; `VectorStore.upsert(rows)` / `query(vector, top_k, label_filter)`.
- `PerLabelRetrieval` ContextPolicy (name `per-label-retrieval`, version `2`): asks each label for k+1, drops the target by ID/text, ties by ID; the shared firewall still validates.
- Config schema §4.2: `retrieval.enabled: false` by default, `per_label`, `combine: add-feature` (only mode), `backend: lexical | embedding`, `store.kind: memory | s3vectors | dynamodb`. Nothing in `fewshot:` reads `retrieval:` and vice versa.
- Fingerprints: retriever config + version (+ embedding model/revision); index = retriever + pool fingerprint; approximate stores record `approximate: true`.

## Definition of done

Specs first: default config makes no retrieval request; enabling retrieval with the optimizer disabled (and the reverse) both validate; unknown keys rejected; fingerprints change with config. `make test` green. Cost: $0.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Retriever interface with an independent retrieval config
  Scenario: Retrieval is off by default
    Given a default flywheel configuration
    When an item is classified with a fake engine
    Then no retrieval index is built and only the default requests are made
  Scenario: Retrieval and the optimizer switch independently
    Given retrieval enabled and the few-shot optimizer disabled
    When the configuration is validated
    Then it is accepted and each fingerprint reflects only its own block
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.1, §4.2.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-e9cfcb6f-2fca-4f4b-b0b2-0a514067828a`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text:
Implemented on branch `phase3-retrieval` (worktree Decision-Flywheel-phase3), commits 0b15981 and fed787d; not merged or pushed. Offline only: specs use fake embedders, no network. `make test` equivalent: 289 passed (226 existing + 63 new).

- Protocols `Retriever` (configuration, fingerprint, `index(task, pool)`), `RetrievalIndex` (fingerprint, `top_per_label(target, label, k, exclude_ids)`), `VectorStore` (approximate, configuration, `upsert(rows)`, `query(vector, top_k, label_filter)`); runtime-checkable.
- `PerLabelRetrieval(retriever, per_label=None, protected_ids=(), protected_input_hashes=())`: name `per-label-retrieval`, version `2`, target-conditioned. Refuses (raises) if an index returns the target, a protected item, an unknown/wrong-label ID or the wrong count; the shared firewall in `build_context_plan` still validates. Index built once per candidate pool.
- Fingerprints: policy = retriever configuration + per_label + hash of protected IDs; index = retriever fingerprint + text-free pool fingerprint; stub stores record `approximate: true`.
- `RetrievalConfig` / `RetrievalConfig.from_mapping` (unknown keys rejected at every level) and `build_retrieval_policy`. The block has no optimizer keys and the optimizer reads nothing from it.
- Open: core has no `fewshot:` config object yet, so the "optimizer disabled and retrieval enabled" scenario is only shown by independence of the two code paths, not by a combined config spec.
